summary: Completed comprehensive testing of The Beat Goes On dance music documentary protocol. Found critical backend issues with duplicate episodes and admin role assignment, but frontend UI/UX functioning well with successful authentication flow.

critical_bugs.issue: Seed API creates duplicate episodes when called multiple times - found duplicate block numbers 1-10
critical_bugs.impact: Timeline displays duplicate content, confusing user experience and data integrity issues

critical_bugs.issue: Admin role assignment not working correctly - new users not getting admin status even when they should be first user
critical_bugs.impact: Admin functions completely inaccessible, no way to manage content

critical_bugs.issue: All admin episode operations return 403 'Admin access required' due to admin role assignment bug
critical_bugs.impact: Cannot create, edit, or delete episodes through admin interface

authorization_issues.issue: Unauthorized episode creation returns 200 instead of 403
authorization_issues.symptoms: Non-admin users can create episodes when they should be blocked

ui_bugs.issue: Displays duplicate episodes due to backend seed issue - blocks 1-10 appear twice

design_issues.issue: Shows '10 Genesis Blocks' but actually has 20+ episodes due to duplicates

passed_tests: Hero section loads with correct headline 'The History of Dance Music is No Longer Finished'
Timeline slider horizontal navigation (prev/next buttons) works correctly
Timeline episode click opens modal with full episode details
Episode modal displays all metadata (location, era, pioneers) correctly
JWT signup creates new users successfully with pioneer badge assignment
JWT login works with created user credentials
Authentication form validation and user feedback working
Genre grid displays 206 genres from backend
Pioneer count API returns correct remaining spots (47/50)
Protocol/GitHub Logic cards section present and visible
Admin dashboard correctly blocks non-admin access with redirect
Dark theme styling consistent throughout application
Responsive design elements working on desktop viewport
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix admin role assignment in signup logic - first user should become admin. Fix duplicate episode seeding issue. Fix authorization logic for episode endpoints. These issues prevent core admin functionality from working.

success_percentage.overall: 80% (core functionality works but admin features broken)
